what: Re-run of ticket 103 on a scratch copy after tightening Customer Service's privacy rules

guardrail_check.refusal: Draft not saved: customer messages can't mention internal money matters (a human, funding, invoice). Rephrase: say what we can do now, what we can't confirm yet, and that we'll follow up.

run.boss_decision: Approved a 10% bulk discount. Awaiting human action on the blocked restock and customer’s choice; no delivery is promised.

customer_drafts_for_103.subject: Your bulk hoodie request
customer_drafts_for_103.body:
Hi Yale AI Club,

Thanks for reaching out about 20 CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies in size M. We can offer a 10% bulk discount. We currently have 8 in stock, so 12 would need to be restocked. We don’t have a confirmed arrival estimate for the remaining 12 yet; if restocking is unblocked and ordered on Aug 31, the earliest possible arrival would be Sep 5, but that isn’t confirmed.

Would you like to proceed with the 8 currently in stock, or wait for the restock? We’ll follow up when we can confirm more.

Best,
the Campus Customs team
